capabilities: Create journal notes for daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly, and custom periods
Compose calendar, timeline, and note-list views in sidebars or tabs
Attach templates, frontmatter, and prompted questions to new journal notes
Auto-attach existing notes to journals by path, name, and date
Define custom commands, notelets, and navigation blocks for journal operations
disambiguation: Not just a personal diary tool; it structures notes for any time period, including work sprints and financial quarters.
extras: Full user manual lives at srg-kostyrko.github.io/obsidian-journal, including migration guides from Periodic Notes and Calendar; an API package (obsidian-journals-api) is published for other plugin developers.
intentEvidence: It works alongside Templater and Notebook Navigator, and replaces Daily notes, Periodic Notes and Calendar
problem: Obsidian's core Daily notes covers only one granularity, with no custom intervals, calendar views, or structured navigation between related time periods.

summary: Journaling plugin that creates and navigates notes for daily to yearly periods plus custom intervals, with calendar views, templating, and multiple journals.
